facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that Niger's government adopted decrees in October 2025 creating the National Cybersecurity Centre (CNAC) and approving its statutes, as a public administrative establishment to coordinate the national strategy.
Agence Ecofin reports that Niger adopted a National Cybersecurity Strategy in December 2022 for 2023-2027.

NER.note: No technical standards for government systems stated.
No government staff running systems stated; the article concerns a planned security operations centre.
A study mission to Burkina Faso's ANSSI under AES cooperation is a visit, not membership of an African digital policy body or a signed agreement.
